tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: The website builders and CMSs there are step-by-step install instructions for, with how long each takes. Call this first when you do not know what the contractor's site is built with.

tools.name: get_install_snippet
tools.description: The exact script tag to paste, plus ordered steps for the given platform. Pass the contractor's own token if you have it; otherwise the snippet comes back with a placeholder and instructions for finding the real one.

tools.name: verify_installation
tools.description: Fetches a public page and reports whether the embed tag is present, whether the token resolves to a real account, whether the widget is actually serving, and what to fix. Use this after the contractor says they have pasted the tag.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live plan prices, trial length, what happens to the card during the trial, and how cancellation works. Read this rather than quoting a price from memory.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: Every trade the product can price from aerial measurement, with what each is measured from - roof surface, ground area, wall area or perimeter - and the national cost range per unit. Use this to answer whether a given business can be quoted this way.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Turns a measurement into a national cost range for a trade. For roof trades, pass the building footprint and the pitch - the roof surface multiplier is applied for you. Returns the range, the per-unit rates, what drives the price, and the limits of the estimate.

tools.name: lead_playbook
tools.description: What actually moves the needle on inbound leads for a specific contracting trade — roofing, paving, landscaping, gutters, siding, decks, pools, turf or solar — with the numbers behind each step.
